subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this feature ship as Control UI-only, or must native WebChat receive matching tool-output URL linkification in the same delivery plan?
rationale: The requested behavior spans two independently rendered clients, while both previous attempts only addressed Control UI and were closed unmerged; source evidence cannot determine the intended product-parity contract.

options.title: Require both clients
options.body: Define shared behavior for Control UI and native WebChat, then land coordinated safe renderers and focused client-specific tests.

options.title: Deliver Control UI first
options.body: Limit the initial work to all Control UI tool-output views and record native WebChat parity as a separately sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Decline automatic linkification
options.body: Retain copyable plain-text tool output and close the feature direction if clickable external links are not desired in tool cards.

recommendation.title: Require both clients
recommendation.body: Define shared behavior for Control UI and native WebChat, then land coordinated safe renderers and focused client-specific tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the affected path and to the existing maintainer-side scope assessment.
